items.q: So first, I went over there and I told Joe I would be able to stay for 2 weeks.

So first, I went over there and I told Joe I would be able to stay for 2 weeks. But, when I got there, I stayed for 4 and then I had to come back. I didn't get the chance to go to England.
Yeah. You also mentioned that Dud Bascomb had told you that in Japan, they knew you and they were waiting for you.
